{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA rows using correct format: '999,999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Count QA rows
num_qa_rows = len(qa_rows)

# Confirm their status
qa_status = qa_rows['status'].unique()

# Compute the count of actual completed orders by excluding QA rows
completed_count = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99')].shape[0]

print(f"Number of QA rows: {num_qa_rows}")
print(f"Status of QA rows: {qa_status}")
print(f"Number of actual completed orders (excluding QA rows): {completed_count}")"}
